execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryBatch" (
  "batchNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "inventoryItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "totalCost" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitCost" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryBatchStock" (
  "batchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "locationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "reservedQuantity" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryLocation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventoryTransfer" (
  "batchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fromLocationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "toLocationId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "finishedProductItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sellingPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."productCostHistory" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hpp" numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."productRecipe" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."production" (
  "batchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "recipeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalHpp" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unitHpp" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recipeItem" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "inventoryItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "recipeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."restock" (
  "batchId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "inventoryItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "totalCost" numeric NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
